main_text.head: LVX ET TENEBRÆ NON coharent sibi mutuo.
main_text.p: [Engraving: a lit candle on a globe with a devil figure, flanked by smoke and flames; not transcribed as text.]
main_text.l: Omnia cum prima sumunt exordia luce,
Optima lux, louæ est cunEti creantis opus?
Non opus est σκότος: est tantum priuatio lucis,
Lux Christi, tenebræ sunt Satanæq; typus.

page.notes: The engraving is an emblem picture with no legible printed text inside it. Line 2 reads "cunctí" in the scan with a doubtful letter; transcribed as printed, "cunEti" is uncertain. The Greek word "σκότος" is printed in small type beside "opus est". The signature at lower right reads "Duc", partly cut off.
